steps.message: When is my next meeting with Aaliyah in Simple Calendar Pro? Express your answer in the format <month name> <day> <year> <hour in 24-hour format>:<minutes>.

Execute: adb shell "date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z %z'; pm list packages | grep -Ei 'simple.*calendar|calendar.*simple|fossify.*calendar'; ls -d /data/data/com.simplemobiletools.calendar.pro /data/user/0/com.simplemobiletools.calendar.pro /data/data/org.fossify.calendar /data/user/0/org.fossify.calendar 2>/dev/null"
